title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Emu's birthday
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay everyone, here we go☆

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Emu, happy birthday♪

rows.Speaker: Luka, MEIKO & KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy birthday!
Happy birthday.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yaaay! Thanks everyone☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's have lots and lots of fun today, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, without further ado, I have a challenge I'd like all of you to take on.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And that is...
A treasure hunt!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A t-treasure hunt?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right! There are jigsaw puzzle pieces hidden all over SEKAI right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The plushies were the ones who hid them, so we have no idea where they are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, we left everything in Rui's hands, so we don't actually know how many puzzle pieces there are, or even what the final picture will be...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. With regards to the final picture, I'd like you all to enjoy the anticipation as we put the puzzle together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I will tell you how many pieces are there. It is a total of...three hundred pieces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Three...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu & Nene
rows.Line: Three hundred?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! There's that much treasure to hunt for?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I thought it would be much more enjoyable to have lots to search for.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can understand that, but still, three hundred jigsaw pieces?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think searching for the pieces alone is going to take up a lot of time. Will we even be able to finish the puzzle today?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Well that will solely depend on how hard we all work♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't brush it off as if this is going to be a walk in the park.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even with that being said, I think we'll do just fine. I limited it to a small portion of SEKAI and had the pieces placed in flashy-looking pouches so that they'd be easier to find.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're also welcome to ask the plushies for some hints.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness. In that case, we might be able to do this by the end of today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then let's go find those puzz...
Zzz... In my...dreams... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah! Luka?! The pieces aren't hidden in your dreams!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Let's go find those pieces☆

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh... There's another one!
Yay! I found ten puzzle pieces so far♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, that's amazing, Miku!
We need to step up our game♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui, Tsukasa! You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Can you...reach it, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: J-Just a little more to the right... Too far! A little more to the left!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How were they even able to get that piece up there? To think that we'd need to ride on each other's shoulders to get it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One of the plushies has a balloon attached to them, so maybe they did it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu, Nene. I'm going to drop this piece down!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, we'll pick it up. Once you're done with that one, could you get the piece above that speaker over there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! There's another one?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Huff huff... I don't think I can do this any longer.
Tsukasa, can we swap for the next one?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Alright...
Let's give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Luka, MEIKO, Len! We got some more puzzle pieces!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh my, you found so many. How much does this make in total, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... That's a total of 105 pieces!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like our hunt will continue for a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Emu, would you like to join us in putting the puzzle together?
I think these pieces will make up this section that looks like a fountain.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Fountain?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! I know this! This piece goes here, and this one over here... And this one goes here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, amazing! You connected them in a blink of an eye!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold on... Do you know what picture this makes up, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I have an idea! Alright, so this piece goes over here...!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh! This is...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had a feeling when we were about halfway done. But it really is Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland at night, huh... It reminds me of the night show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We worked so hard for it too, didn't we?☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we're missing the pieces that make up the Phenny on top of the fountain.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes... I suppose we're missing three pieces.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We found all of the pieces that were hidden in SEKAI, so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu. Have you received anything from anybody?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? I received a lot of gifts yesterday, but...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! I found an envelope that said I should open it if I'm in a pinch!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ah, there's a birthday card and...three puzzle pieces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent. Put those in and the puzzle is complete!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: By the way, what's written on the card?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“We will be having a party for you tonight, so don't come home too late.
From K.S.H., Mom and Dad”♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (My family organized all of this just for me... Hehehe, that makes me so happy!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's complete the puzzle, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! And let's also dig into the cake and snacks to our hearts' content!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu! Thank you for sending us photos of the cookie Wonder Stage♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know we were the ones who planned it, but it was still surprising to actually see the Wonder Stage made out of cookies.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. We couldn't have been able to do it without our PXL expert Kohane's help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But all of you guys were really amazing too for following the templates perfectly to make the cookies!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Well, that was because we had the ever-benevolent Hona there with us♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It was pretty difficult, but it was really fun baking cookies with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu, thank you for always being cheerful and making us smile. I hope our gift gave you even just a little bit of joy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope you have an amazing birthday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu! I'm glad that you liked our gift!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I heard that she took lots of photos of the cookie Wonder Stage and showed it around to the PXL cast members too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I received a message from Tsukasa saying, “Thank you for doing that for Emu.”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that she liked it more than we expected.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Emu. I hope you continue to make lots more wonderful shows with your troupe! As an idol and your school senior, I'll be cheering you on♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Otori. It'll be a little belated, but I'd like to tell you this again in person the next time I see you at school.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I heard it was your birthday, Otori. Happy birthday. You'll be celebrating with Kusanagi and the others today, right? I hope you have lots of fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright then, once again...
Happy birthday, Emu♪ Have you been having lots of fun? Thanks for already coloring in those coloring sheets!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You colored all of them so well too. The details you added to the flowers and animals made them so lively. I could really see you in the way you colored them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You said it! I hope you continue to keep doing your best with a smile on your face! We're rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Emu. The treasure hunt was kinda tough, but it was fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. From searching for the pieces to completing the puzzle... I think all of it was worth the effort in the end, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I was a little apprehensive when I heard there were three hundred pieces, but once we figured out the final picture, it was worth it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But above all, I'm glad that Emu spent the day with a smile on her face!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu. As your fellow troupe member, I look forward to the next step on our journey.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No matter what happens, if we're together, it'll work out. Let's do our best, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So many people wished me a happy birthday and celebrated with me♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: From the cookie Wonder Stage to the coloring sheets and the Phoenix Wonderland jigsaw puzzle, all of the gifts made me so happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That reminds me! I've gotta show Shosuke, Keisuke and Sis that I finished the puzzle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh yeah, and maybe I'll change the decorations on the cookie Wonder Stage with them♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. There's so many things I wanna do that I can't stand still!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, time to dash home♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here I go! Won-won-wonderhoy dash!
